title: docket saved plan
description: The file `docket plan --output` writes and `docket apply --plan` reads. Like the task catalog, and unlike the JSON-lines streams, this describes one whole document - validate it as a unit. It holds every resolved input in the clear, sensitive ones included. See docs/command-reference.md#saved-plans.

format.description: Marks the document as a docket saved plan.

version.description: The saved plan's wire format. Independent of the --json event stream's version.

docket_version.description: The docket version that wrote the plan. `apply --plan` refuses a plan written by any other version. Empty for an unversioned build.

created_at.description: When the plan was written, RFC 3339 in UTC.

source.description: Where the recipe was read from - a path, a URL, or `<stdin>`. Display only; the recipe is never read from it again.

data.description: The recipe text exactly as the plan read it.

inputs.description: Every input the recipe declares, keyed by name, resolved to the value the plan rendered with.

play.description: The --play the plan was made with; empty when every play was planned.

tags.description: The --tags the plan was made with.

skip_tags.description: The --skip-tags the plan was made with.

target.description: The run-wide target the plan probed, after --host / --sudo / --accept-new-host-keys and their environment variables. A play's own host:, sudo: and accept_new_host_keys: still come from the recipe.

events.description: The plan's fingerprint: every play and task event in order, without timing or warnings, masked as the --json stream masks them. `apply --plan` probes again and refuses to run when the result differs.

type.description: The input's declared type; `value` is parsed as it.

value.description: The resolved value, spelled as a string. Not masked, even for a sensitive input.

sensitive.description: Whether the recipe declared the input `sensitive: true`.

has_default.description: Whether the recipe declared a non-empty `default:`.

user_set.description: Whether the value came from the command line or a --vars-file rather than the recipe.

play.description: The enclosing play, on a `task` event.

host.description: The play's remote host, on a `play_start` event.

when.description: The play's `when:` source, on a `play_skipped` event.

status.description: The task's plan marker, on a `task` event.

mutations.description: The changes the task would make.

commands.description: The masked dokku commands apply would run, as of the plan.

phase.description: The group clause a child task belongs to.

group.description: True on a group's own summary event.
